Lǜ Sēnlín Frame™ Towers

Our equipment is built around stackable “frames” — compact, modular units: 1000mm × 500mm × 500mm (L × W × H), that form vertical towers. Frames are lightweight, made from self-healing nanomaterials for durability, and feature plug-and-play slots for growing modules (eg hydroponic pods, aquaponic tanks).
